name: Greater Iron Will
body:
Your superior force of will allows you to resist both magical and mundane fear.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Iron Will.

Benefit(s): Any effect that would normally cause you to become cowering, frightened, or panicked, instead only makes you shaken for the same duration.
